categories.main_business_segments: Primax Technology operates primarily in three segments: Information Products (including computer peripherals such as keyboards, mice, touchpads, and gaming devices), Smart Living (covering smart audio products like wireless speakers, microphones, and smart home devices), and Automotive & Smart IoT (including automotive camera modules, industrial IoT devices, and security surveillance products). The company also develops professional acoustic products and office automation equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies in visual imaging, acoustics, and human-machine interfaces, focusing on 'X-IN-1 Sensory Fusion' integrating multiple sensory inputs with AI capabilities. It employs advanced manufacturing processes including automated production lines, AI-driven digital signal processing, and eco-friendly materials. Production bases in China and Thailand utilize flexible and scalable manufacturing with strict quality control and supply chain integration.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primax serves major international technology companies across personal computing, consumer electronics, automotive, and industrial sectors. Key markets include PC and gaming peripherals, smart home audio and IoT devices, automotive electronics for advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS), and security surveillance systems. Customers are primarily global OEMs and brand owners in electronics and automotive industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with manufacturing and R&D facilities in Taiwan, China (Dongguan, Kunshan, Chongqing, Huizhou), Thailand, Singapore, and subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Cayman Islands, UK, and Europe. Major sales markets include China, the United States, Europe, and other regions, with a strategic focus on expanding presence in Southeast Asia and global automotive and smart IoT markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Primax functions mainly as a midstream manufacturer and system integrator within the electronics supply chain. It sources components such as sensors, chips, and materials from upstream suppliers and delivers assembled modules and finished products to downstream OEMs and brand companies. The company also engages in design and development, positioning itself as a key technology partner in the value chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The strategic focus centers on advancing multi-sensory fusion technologies integrating vision, acoustics, and AI to drive innovation in smart living, automotive electronics, and industrial IoT. R&D priorities include AI-enabled audiovisual solutions, edge computing, low-power wireless charging, and eco-friendly product design. The company invests heavily in expanding production capacity, especially in Thailand, and enhancing automation and sustainability in manufacturing.
categories.revenue_model: Primax generates revenue primarily through product sales of hardware components and modules, including computer peripherals, smart audio devices, automotive camera modules, and security systems. Revenue is derived from long-term contracts with global OEMs and brand owners, supplemented by licensing of proprietary technologies and customized solution development services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Primax competes with global electronics manufacturers and module suppliers in the computer peripherals, smart audio, automotive electronics, and security surveillance markets. It differentiates itself through integrated multi-sensory AI solutions, strong R&D capabilities, and diversified global manufacturing footprint. The company maintains a competitive position by focusing on high-value, innovative products and close collaboration with leading technology brands.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, Primax reported consolidated net revenue of approximately NT$58.2 billion, a slight decrease of 3.7% from the prior year, with net profit increasing by 3.6% to about NT$2.7 billion. The company maintains a healthy financial structure with steady cash flow from operations, ongoing capital investments in production expansion, and a consistent dividend payout. Growth is driven by expanding automotive and smart IoT product lines and increasing production capacity in Southeast Asia.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Primax emphasizes its unique 'multi-sensory fusion' technology integrating vision, acoustics, and AI to deliver innovative, high-quality products that enhance user experience across computing, smart living, and automotive applications. Its competitive advantages include advanced R&D, flexible global manufacturing, strong customer partnerships, and commitment to sustainability and green design, enabling tailored solutions that meet evolving market demands and regulatory requirements.
